todo_line: - [ ] 001 Inventory club-member LiveViews and projection-backed reads, existing refresh predicates, fresh authorization sources and access transitions; record queries to migrate, event/interest mappings, focused test evidence and justified exceptions.
outcome: Create `docs/iterations/067-live-projection-queries/.delivery/member-liveview-migration-matrix.md` as the implementation-ready inventory for all seven LiveView modules in the `:club_member` live session, with one proposed query-result assign per surface and explicit read, invalidation, authorization, transition, transient-state, and focused-proof mappings.
scope: Inventory the seven modules routed by `web/lib/memba_web/router.ex` under `live_session :club_member`: `MemberDashboardLive`, `MemberGroupLive.New`, `MemberInvitationLive.New`, `MemberMessageLive.New`, `MemberMessageLive.Show`, `MemberMessageDeliveryLive.Show`, and `MySettingsLive`; verify that each uses ordinary assigns rather than streams.

For each module, record its routes, projection-backed display reads and current loader symbols, the proposed coherent query/view-model assign, current manual refresh predicates or absence of refresh, fresh authorization inputs, existing forbidden/not-found/navigation transition, transient assigns that must remain outside the query, and existing versus missing focused evidence.

Keep the dashboard as one coherent authorized result around `MemberDashboardPresentation.load/4`; include selected club/group, member rows and counts, conversations, permissions/access, candidates, and represented people rather than proposing independently refreshed dashboard fields.

Record a per-query event-to-interest matrix keyed by both projector and source-event type. Include collection interests needed for rows entering or leaving, represented record identities, same/old/new scope information, independently committed projector notifications, and a documented conservative fallback whenever an event lacks precise scope.

At minimum assess Club, Group, Membership, GroupMembership, Person, Role, Message, ConversationGroupAccess, ConversationFollow, MemberEmailDelivery, and MembaStaffEmailDelivery projectors. Record ClubInvitation, base EmailDelivery, and InboundEmailSource as justified non-interests if direct inspection still shows that they contribute no continuously displayed result.

Record the existing focused test evidence and the missing proof needed by later tasks, including the approved `@iteration-067` member-entry example, member entry/removal/order/counts, external reply arrival, delivery-status refresh, role/membership loss on open forms/settings, unrelated-club isolation, transient-state preservation, reconnect/bind races, and a real committed-projector-to-open-LiveView path.

Identify any genuine whole-LiveView exception explicitly. Current inspection found no in-scope member module that merits an exception; projection-backed context should be separated from forms, validation, command state, generated IDs, tabs, picker/search state, reply/send state, success/focus state, and input-derived group preview.
scope_exclusions: Do not edit application code, tests, acceptance features, ADRs, the approved plan, or the todo; this packet produces only the migration-matrix document.
Do not design or freeze the generic package API, implement subscriptions or adapters, migrate a LiveView, enable acceptance scenarios, or add tests; those remain tasks 003-008.

Do not complete task 002's detailed staff-stream inventory. Mark staff, public, auth/onboarding, and stream-backed surfaces as deferred scope boundaries only, without changing them or claiming task 002 complete.
Do not treat command forms, validation state, navigation state, or transient input-derived previews as projection query results.
Do not infer a business-policy change for invitation or settings access gaps; record the current behaviour, approved fresh-authorization requirement, and implementation proof needed.
constraints: Use inspected code and tests as ground truth. The router currently establishes seven in-scope module boundaries; five have hand-written ReadModelChanges subscriptions while group creation and invitation have none.

A source event may be published after several projectors commit independently, so map projector plus event and never use one projector's notification as evidence that another projector's rows have committed.

The notification `changes` value is projector-specific Ecto.Multi output, not a normalized old/new record. Prefer stable event fields and document lookup-derived or conservative invalidation where needed.

Fresh authorization cannot rely only on mount-captured `current_identity_clubs`. Record how each refresh reacquires current club membership, group participation, role permission, and conversation access from the stable identity and current projection or authoritative APIs.

Person email events have person identity but no club/group scope even though active-member queries depend on primary email rows; record identity matching plus lookup-derived or conservative affected collection invalidation.

`MessageSent` has club and conversation identity but no audience group; record conversation identity plus conservative club-conversation invalidation until a precise ConversationGroupAccess commit can match a group collection.

The shared member receipt loader joins member and staff delivery projections for status and reason, so detail queries that display receipts must account for both projector families and ignore documented no-op replay events.
Subscribe-before-read and bind-time reconciliation are known requirements, but their API and proof belong to task 003; the matrix should state them as later proof needs, not choose an implementation.

Preserve existing private-surface semantics in the matrix: dashboard forbidden/not-found behaviour and compose/conversation/delivery navigation on lost access. Flag the current invitation submit-time authorization and settings membership-loss gaps for later implementation proof.
Keep the document concise enough to act as an implementation checklist while giving every row explicit symbols, interests, authority, transition, transient exclusions, and test citations.
completion_evidence_required: Return the exact changed-file list; it should contain only the migration-matrix document for this worker packet.
Summarize the seven proposed query-result boundaries and identify any justified whole-surface exception.

Confirm that every query row records concrete read symbols, projector/event interests with entry/exit and conservative fallback treatment, fresh authorization source, access transition, transient exclusions, and focused evidence.
List current handler mismatches and missing tests that later implementation tasks must close, including which existing test is the real committed-projector-to-open-view proof.
Report the focused validation commands and exit results; do not run the repository-wide dev check for this documentation-only packet.
